hook: His career batting average: 99.94. No one else in history has finished above 62.
story: His name was Donald Bradman, and his sport was cricket, where a batting average is the runs you score for every time you're out. Above 50, you're an all-time great. Bradman grew up in Bowral, Australia, practicing alone with a golf ball and a cricket stump against a water tank. In 1930 he scored 974 runs in one series. England invented an entirely new style of bowling just to slow him down.

full_text: His career batting average: 99.94. No one else in history has finished above 62. His name was Donald Bradman, and his sport was cricket, where a batting average is the runs you score for every time you're out. Above 50, you're an all-time great. Bradman grew up in Bowral, Australia, practicing alone with a golf ball and a cricket stump against a water tank. In 1930 he scored 974 runs in one series. England invented an entirely new style of bowling just to slow him down. In a century and a half of Test cricket, the best completed career apart from his ended at 61.87. His: 99.94. One statistician did the math: to dominate basketball like this, Michael Jordan would have needed a career average of 43 points a game. Jordan retired at 30. In his final innings, he needed four runs to end at exactly 100. England's players cheered him to the crease. He was bowled for nothing, second ball, and never batted again.
